name: Omnodex sealed capture
description: Installs Omnodex and sets up Claude Code, Codex and other agent hooks to capture sealed events to write-only ingest, so a disposable container loses nothing. Needs OMNODEX_INGEST_PUBLIC_KEY and OMNODEX_INGEST_SOURCE_ID in the container environment (Codespaces secrets work); nothing secret is stored.

agents.description: Comma-separated agents to capture: claude-code, codex, copilot, cursor, antigravity.

version.description: Version of the omnodex npm package to install.
